messages.author: 0a65d6b5546cfe9e
messages.subject: Problem deploying shinyapps
parts:
Hello,

I can not open https://my.shinyapps.io/ and I can not deploy my application, I obtain this:

> deployApp()
Preparing to deploy application...
Error in function (type, msg, asError = TRUE)  : 
  Unknown SSL protocol error in connection to api.shinyapps.io:443 
Timing stopped at: 0.03 0 28.08 

Can anyone help me?
Thank you.
